content:
NOTE: In using OATTS to familiarize yourself with the AFOQT and TBAS, you will also have an opportunity to volunteer for research into its efficacy. If interested, you may participate by exporting and sharing your data via email. 
Participation is entirely voluntary. You do not need to participate to make full use of OATTS. 
You can click the link to export data at any time and will be prompted with full informed consent upon completion of your modules. 
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Terms and Conditions of Use
Effective Date: 09 DECEMBER  2025  
NOTICE: This is an experimental tool under development and in BETA. It is designed to ready users to take specific tests, but it does not guarantee improvements. Data is still being collected on its efficacy. Your choice to use the tool is voluntary and may assist in its ongoing development.

1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using the Official AFOQT & TBAS Test-Familiarization Software (“OATTS”), you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions (“Terms”), which govern your use of OATTS. If you do not agree to these Terms, you may not use OATTS.

2. Purpose

The OATTS is designed to support those preparing for the Air Force Officer Qualifying Test (AFOQT) Form T and the Test of Basic Aviation Skills (TBAS) by providing instructional content, practice materials, and resources to manage test-related stress. The platform is provided by the United States Department of the Air Force (“DAF”).

3. Eligibility

You must be an authorized user— 

Use of OATTS is limited to authorized users only, including:
•	Individuals planning to take the AFOQT and/or TBAS for the purpose of entrance into an authorized training program of the United States Air Force (“USAF”) or Space Force (“USSF”);
•	Educators, administrators, officers, or other support personnel acting within the scope of their professional roles;
Users under the age of 18 may only use OATTS if:
•	They have obtained verifiable parental or guardian consent, or
•	They are contractually engaged with the USAF or USSF and have been granted independent access as part of that relationship (e.g., through enlistment, pre-employment programs, or authorized testing pathways).
All such users must still comply with these Terms and any additional applicable laws, program policies, or directives issued by the DAF or its authorized representatives.

4. User Conduct
You agree not to:
•	Misuse or disrupt the functionality of OATTS
•	Share access credentials with other users
•	Upload or distribute malicious software or offensive content
•	Use OATTS for any commercial purposes or unauthorized solicitation

5. Intellectual Property
All content, including instructional materials, videos, practice questions, and embedded resources, is the intellectual property of DAF, except where otherwise indicated, or its licensors and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. Logos and branding associated with any government entity remain the property of that entity.

6. Data and Privacy
OATTS may collect data to improve functionality and track user progress. Personally identifiable information (PII) will be collected, stored on your local machine and handled in accordance with applicable federal and state privacy laws, including but not limited to [FERPA or COPPA]. 
If you volunteer to submit your data for research purposes, your PII will be anonymized, encrypted and aggregated. Once received, data will be added to a central repository without any PII. No one, including researchers, will be able to identify your user data with your identity in the aggregated form.  

7. No Guarantee of Performance
While OATTS is intended to improve test familiarity and reduce stress, DAF does not guarantee specific test outcomes or results. Content is for general purposes only and may not increase future performance on AFOQT, TBAS, or any other exam.

8. Limitation of Liability
To the fullest extent permitted by law, DAF shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use OATTS, including but not limited to issues related to content accuracy, connectivity, or emotional impact.

9. Modifications
We reserve the right to modify or update these Terms at any time. Continued use of OATTS after changes are made constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

10. Contact
For technical support, accessibility accommodations, or questions regarding these Terms, contact:
Email: OATTScontact@dcscorp.com
